A tidier settings popup.

### Changed
- **Floatplane creators in a dropdown:** the Floatplane row opens and closes the creator list, so it starts the same height as the Nebula row and still shows how many creators you've selected.
- **Clearer wording:** "Settings" instead of "On YouTube", "When a video is somewhere I subscribe" for the redirect choice, and shorter descriptions.
- **Refresh data** moved into Settings.
- The popup is a fixed width, so it no longer changes size as you use it.

### Removed
- Hiding channel banners. Banners no longer have a close button, and the "Show hidden banners" button is gone.

Everything else is as in [0.5.3](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.3).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
